item.title: Tokachi Millennium Forest Guide: Gardens, Tickets & Access
item.description: In the rolling countryside of the Tokachi plain lies the Tokachi Millennium Forest, one of Japan’s most celebrated contemporary gardens. Conceived as a 1,000-year project to reconnect people with nature, it blends manicured garden artistry with the wild Hokkaido landscape — most famously the sculpted, wave-like grass mounds of the Earth Garden and the lush perennial borders of the Meadow Garden, designed by acclaimed plantsman Piet Oudolf. An international garden-design award-winner, it’s a serene, beautiful stop, with goats, cafés, cycling and forest trails to enjoy at a gentle pace.
